description: The Odoo write log of this tenant: one entry per change made through DelegAIze, newest first — time, tool, Odoo model, Odoo id, the record's NAME and the outcome (ok/failed). The entry is written BEFORE the change is sent, so failed attempts show up too. Filter: tool_name. Changes nothing.

tool_name.description: Only entries written by this tool (e.g. create_odoo_partner)

name: list_odoo_write_log
